name: ER34615

codes.note: Not printed on the Saft sheet fetched; standard designation for this D-size Li-SOCl2 battery.
Version recommended for cool temperature environments.
Tadiran D-size model; no Tadiran sheet was fetched.

dimensions.note: Saft LS 33600C lists 33.4mm maximum diameter and a maximum height of 60.2 or 61.6mm depending on version.

variants.notes: Data are for the Saft LS 33600C. Saft lists 80mA as the continuous current that still delivers 50 percent of nominal capacity.

safety: Single-use lithium batteries are not rechargeable; charging, short circuit, crushing, disassembly or heating above 100°C can cause fire, explosion or venting.
Do not solder directly to the battery; use tabbed or pinned versions.
Lithium thionyl chloride batteries run at 3.6V; most 1.5V devices are not designed for that voltage.
Saft notes that currents above the recommended continuous level may require thermal protection.
notes: Industrial D-size bobbin battery with a high capacity for long-life, low-drain devices.

sources.title: Saft LS 33600C primary lithium battery data sheet
